### 🟢 Approval recommended The focused fix addresses the reported failure with regression coverage and no identified blocking issues; tests were not executed during review. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes Anthropic stream error handling so callers receive a readable `HttpException` instead of a `TypeError`. **Changes:** - Formats error objects into messages while preserving string errors. - Adds regression tests for normal streams and errors after partial text. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​Unit/​Chat/​Anthropic/​AnthropicStreamResponseTest.php | Tests successful streams and readable error exceptions. | | src/​Chat/​Anthropic/​AnthropicStreamResponse.php | Converts stream error payloads into exception messages. |
